subtitle: A 200-by-50-foot nude-bathing zone Toronto legalized here in 1894 is called the world's oldest official nude beach; by the 1940s the same sand had become one of Canada's earliest queer gathering places.
spike_statement: Toronto's 1894 by-law legalizing nude bathing on a 200-by-50-foot strip here is called the world's oldest official nude-beach zoning.

levers.photo_tone: Lake Ontario grey-blue under a hazy downtown skyline, driftwood-toned sand narrowed by erosion, small Pride flags the only saturated color
